author: Nick Smith

sections.description:
EZ Horoscope is the Astrology, Horoscope, and Tarot platform for WordPress.

Horoscope Content Now in 45 languages!
Pro version now includes awesome Tarot Card Readings!! (Beta)

Our core platform is free and has everything you need to display beautiful and engaging horoscopes for each of the zodiac signs.

  • Create Stunning, Engaging Horoscopes for each of the 12 zodiac signs, keeping your readers intrigued and eager for more.
  • Daily and Weekly Horoscopes all content is automated automatically.
  • Boost Traffic and Ad Revenue with irresistible daily content that drives clicks and encourages return visits.
  • Daily Fresh Insights Our horoscopes are crafted every day with new guidance, advice, and planetary influences, ensuring your content stays relevant and captivating.
  • NASA-Backed Cosmic Precision We calculate cosmic influences daily using NASA’s astronomical ephemeris, providing the most accurate astrological guidance.
  • Track Every Retrograde Stay ahead of every planetary retrograde, with clear explanations of how each retrograde affects your zodiac sign’s unique path.
  • Detailed Planetary Aspects Including trines, oppositions, and more—every aspect is interpreted and delivered for each zodiac sign’s horoscope.
  • Lunar Phases and Folklore Learn how each phase of the moon and its folklore affects your readers, creating a deeper connection to the universe.
  • Influences of 15 Fixed Stars From Sirius to Regulus, our plugin tracks and interprets the daily conjunctions between these stars and the planets, adding depth to your horoscopes.
    —Beautifully written See examples!
  • Effortless Setup Up and running in minutes with a simple shortcode —no coding required. Start offering daily and weekly horoscopes that keep your audience coming back!
  • Customizable Design Tailor the look of your horoscopes to match your website’s unique style. Adjust background colors, fonts, and sizes to create a seamless experience that fits perfectly with your theme.
  • Premium Features Available Upgrade to the premium version to unlock advanced features, including Tarot Cards, and individual horoscope components for greater customization of the look and feel of your horoscopes, as well as the ability to disable affiliate promotions, links, and call-to-actions.

Affiliate Disclosure

Some horoscope content generated by this plugin may include affiliate links and promotions. This means that if users click on a link and make a purchase, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. This helps support the continuous development of the plugin and the servers and bandwidth to deliver the content. These links and promotions can be disabled in the Professional Version.

Premium Features

Upgrade the Professional Plan for access to tech support and these additional features (check it out with free 14 day trial):
Create your own horoscope and astrology pages by combining components of the horoscope using the [ezhp_ezhoroscope_section sign=”zodiac sign” section=”horoscope section” language=”languageCode”] short code pattern. This will allow you more flexibility over the look and feel of your horoscope pages while still giving you all of the benefits of content that is updated daily and automatically. Mix and match components including the advice section, guidance section, conclusion section, and any or all of the planetary, sun, and lunar sections from the detailed cosmic guidance. Use these components individually or collectively in your astrology and horoscope pages or posts to display accurate and beautifully written astrological content with your own look and feel.
– Change top headline tag level or suppress it altogether in the daily horoscope
– Flexible customization
– Individual components
– Guidance section
– Advice section
– Reflection section
– Lunar phase
– Individual sun and planetary aspects
– Disable all affiliate promotions and links
– Beautiful and impressive Tarot card readings (Beta, not yet translated or with customization)

Privacy Notice

By activating this plugin, you agree to share the following data with us:
– The URL of the website where the plugin is activated.
– The date and time of plugin activation.
This data is used solely for tracking plugin activations and improving our services. We do not collect any personal user information.

For more information, please see our privacy policy at:

sections.installation:
Follow these simple steps to download, install, and activate the EZ Horoscope Plugin on your WordPress site:

Install the Plugin via the WordPress Repository

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard (https://yoursite.com/wp-admin).
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “EZ Horoscope Plugin.”
  4. Click Install Now, and then click Activate.

To display daily horoscopes, use the shortcode: [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign=”zodiacsign” language=”languagecode”] in your posts or pages.
Replace “zodiacsign” with the desired zodiac sign, replace languagecode with your desired language (e.g., [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign=”aquarius” language=”fr”]).

To display weekly horoscopes, use the shortcode: [ezhp_ezweeklyhoroscope sign=”zodiacsign” language=”languagecode”].
sections.faq:
How do I display a horoscope for a specific zodiac sign?

Use the shortcode [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign="zodiac_sign" language="languagecode"] in any post or page. Replace zodiac_sign with one of the following:
– aries
– taurus
– gemini
– cancer
– leo
– virgo
– libra
– scorpio
– sagittarius
– capricorn
– aquarius
– pisces

Example: [ezhp_ezhoroscope sign="leo" language="es"] displays the daily horoscope for Leo in Spanish. [ezhp_ezweeklyhoroscope sign="leo" language="bn"] displays the weekly horoscope in Bengali.

How often is the horoscope content updated?

The horoscope content is updated daily, ensuring fresh horoscopes are always displayed.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes, the iframe containing the horoscope content adjusts to fit mobile and desktop screens.

What languages are available?

We support 45 different languages.
Visit our ezhoroscope instructions page to see the supported languages and language codes
